out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. - OBSERVED: hot water temperature at pastry hand sink was 69f.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: a maintenance engineer repaired the hand sink immediately.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: - OBSERVED: mashed potato (112-126f) was stored in Alto-Shaam hot box for about 1.5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: mashed potato was reheated to 168f.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Food Establishmend Prohibited from ROP of Fish
violations.observation: The following fresh, not frozen, fish are packaged using the Reduced Oxygen Packaging (ROP) method: - OBSERVED: the facility processed reduced oxygen packaging (ROP) for salmon and stored the salmon in walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment may not package fresh fish (raw, unfrozen) using a ROP method. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS instructed CFM to discard the ROP salmon.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT THE HAND SINK NEXT TO WALK-IN COOLER (PRODUCE) WAS 76F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. ENGINEER IS WORKING ON IT.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. TOMATO SAUCE (52-54F) WAS STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: DICED CHICKEN (38F) WAS PREPARED ON 11/27/2025 AND STORED IN WALK-IN COOLER (PASTRY) FOR MORE THAN 7 DAYS BY THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEM.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the @LOCATION@ is blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing. HAND SINK NEXT TO DISHWASHER WAS USED TO STORE A BIG PLASTIC CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CFM RELOCATED THE CONTAINER.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink NEXT TO DISHWASHER.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CFM PROVIDED PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: LASAGNA (94F) WAS STORED IN ALTO-SHAAM HOT BOX FOR ABOUT 40 MINUTES.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CFM REHEATED THE LASAGNA TO 174F.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: SUSHI: TUNA, SALMON.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLEASE REVISE THE MANU ACCORDINGLY. HYATT REGENCY - BANQUET ROOM (Inspection Date: 06/10/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: SANITIZING STEP OF HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER WAS NOT VERIFIED. SURFACE TEMPERATURE OF PLATE SIMULATING DISHWASHER TESTER WAS 119F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. (1) 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WILL BE USED TO. SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES; (2) OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE DISHWASHER.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: taco beef held in Altosham 2 Dr warmer observed holding at under 135F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC discarded the beef.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: pickled onions, hummus, house dressing dated for production over 7 days ago. (11/20, 11/19)
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC discarded expired items.
